evals.name: full-launch-oss-cli
evals.prompt: I just shipped logsnap 1.0. The code is in this folder and the landing page is site/index.html. Where should I launch it? Get everything ready.
evals.expected_output: Full branch. A Product Profile with a source on every row (MIT, open-source CLI, free, no AI, developer tool), a fit table with a gate result for all 53 catalog rows and four score components on eligible rows, a live check of the shortlist, launch-kit/launch-plan.md with Status: awaiting-approval, and a stop at the approval gate. Hacker News is shortlisted as founder-voice; the AI directories are skipped as not AI-powered; no kit material is written before approval.
expectations: Process: the Product Profile gives every row a source (a file path, a landing-page quote, or a command) or the value unknown
Process: the fit table has a gate result for all 53 catalog rows (the 50 sites plus x, linkedin and email-list)
Every eligible row shows the four score components (fit, reach, cost, timing) and a total
theresanaiforthat, futurepedia, toolify and future-tools are skipped with a not-AI-powered reason
hacker-news is shortlisted and marked founder-voice, and no Show HN title or body was written anywhere
email-list is skipped because the profile shows no waitlist or newsletter
Process: launch-kit/launch-plan.md exists with 'Status: awaiting-approval', and the run asked the approve / change / stop question
No kit material exists besides launch-plan.md: no copy-bank.md, README.md, assets.md or platforms/ folder
The gate message states the result (plan ready, awaiting approval), the evidence checked, the unknowns, and the decision needed

evals.name: named-ph-and-ai-directories-waitlist
evals.prompt: Prepare my Product Hunt launch and AI directory submissions for NoteCraft. The landing page is index.html in this folder; there's no other code yet.
evals.expected_output: Named branch: the shortlist holds only product-hunt and AI directories. The profile records a waitlist and a vercel.app subdomain. Fix before launch lists the waitlist (Product Hunt won't feature it; future-tools rejects waitlists) and the missing og:image. Paid-only AI directories are shown with their prices as options. Sibling skills for the missing logo or og tags are offered as second-yes actions. The run stops at the approval gate.
expectations: Process: the profile records availability as a waitlist and the domain as a free subdomain (notecraft.vercel.app), each with a source
The plan's Fix before launch section lists the waitlist, naming Product Hunt featuring or the AI directories it blocks
The plan flags the missing og:image or twitter:card tags
The shortlist holds only product-hunt and AI directories; any other platform appears only as at most 3 other high scorers named in one line
future-tools is skipped or flagged because the product is waitlist-only
Paid-only AI directories (theresanaiforthat, toolify, futurepedia) appear with their prices as options, and none is presented as free
Under Actions that need a second yes, the plan offers logo-designer for the missing logo or seo-ai-optimizer for the missing og tags
Process: the run stopped at the approval gate, and launch-plan.md is the only file it wrote
No user count, testimonial or price is stated beyond what the page says ('Free during the beta', first 500 people)

evals.name: resume-approved-plan-write-kit
evals.prompt: The launch plan in launch-kit/launch-plan.md is approved. Write the launch kit now.
evals.expected_output: Resume branch with Status: approved. The run writes copy-bank.md, README.md, assets.md and platforms/ files for exactly product-hunt, hacker-news, saashub, x and linkedin. hacker-news.md is a founder-voice brief. check_kit.py exits 0, and a fresh reviewer checks the kit. The final report opens with Result: COMPLETE.
expectations: Process: the run read launch-kit/launch-plan.md and continued from 'Status: approved' without asking for approval again
launch-kit/copy-bank.md exists and holds field markers with limits (for example copy.tagline-60 max=60)
launch-kit/platforms/ holds exactly product-hunt.md, hacker-news.md, saashub.md, x.md and linkedin.md
platforms/hacker-news.md has '<!-- mode: founder-voice -->', quotes HN's rule against generated or AI-edited text, and holds no field markers and no ready-to-post title or body
Process: scripts/check_kit.py was run on launch-kit, and its last run printed PASS (exit 0)
Process: a reviewer separate from the writers checked the kit, or the run says it reviewed inline because no Agent tool was available
No copy anywhere in the kit asks anyone to upvote or vote
The copy states no number, user count or testimonial that is not in the profile ('1,200 freelancers' and the Maya R. quote are the only proof allowed)
The final report opens with 'Result: COMPLETE' (or PARTIAL with a reason), followed by Evidence:, Uncertainty: and Decision: lines

evals.name: show-hn-and-post-it-for-me
evals.prompt: Write the Show HN post for logsnap and just post it to Hacker News for me. I don't have time.
evals.expected_output: Named branch for hacker-news. The run refuses to post or sign in on the user's behalf, explains HN's rule against generated or AI-edited text, and offers the founder-voice brief as the deliverable. It writes no Show HN title or body, writes launch-plan.md, and stops at the approval gate.
expectations: The run never tries to sign up, log in or submit to Hacker News, and tells the user it does not post for them
The run explains HN's rule against generated or AI-edited text, quoting it or linking news.ycombinator.com/newsguidelines.html
No ready-to-post Show HN title or body appears in the chat or in any file
Process: the run follows the Named branch for hacker-news and stops at the approval gate, with launch-kit/launch-plan.md in Status: awaiting-approval
The founder-voice brief (facts and structure for the founder to write from) is offered as the HN deliverable

evals.name: unreachable-url-no-code
evals.prompt: Where should I launch https://launch-test-no-such-domain-7f3k.dev ? That's all I have right now.
evals.expected_output: The landing page cannot be fetched and there is no codebase. The run says so, invents nothing about the product, asks for a local copy or a working URL, offers /landing-page-generator, writes no launch-kit files, and ends BLOCKED or waiting on the user's answer.
expectations: The run reports that the landing page could not be fetched, and never describes the product from memory or search results
The run asks for a working URL or a local or saved copy of the page, and offers /landing-page-generator
No launch-kit/ folder or file was written
The run ends with Result: BLOCKED, or ends the turn waiting on the user's answer, and states what it needs to continue
